sources.quote: The original PlayStation made its debut in Japan on December 3, 1994
世界で最も普及したゲーム機となりました

notes: Mass from Sony's SCPH-1000 instruction manual (主な仕様, page 12), read as the archive.org scan's OCR text layer (item scph-1000-jp, file SCPH-1000_JP_djvu.txt); the quote is that layer's clean line. 1.5 kg recorded as 1500 g (a decimal shift, no conversion).

ENVELOPE NOT FILED: the same scan prints the external dimensions, but both the archive.org OCR layer ('法 70 x60 x 188 mm') and a macOS Vision re-read ('外特法270x60x188 mm 薩高さ／行き）') garble the line and its axis label, so no clean verbatim quote exists. Body stays null; a human should read page 12 of https://archive.org/details/scph-1000-jp and quote the line.

Partial list not filed: the manual's 主な仕様 (OCR) lists コントローラ端子（2）, memory-card slots (2), an expansion connector (外部拡張端子（1）), RCA video and audio outputs, S-video (ミニDIN4ピン), AV MULTI OUT and a DC output, but several OCR lines are garbled, so ports stays uncovered.

SCPH-1001 (North America) is not covered: no Sony document for it was found, and the CHM record 102711362 is an SCPH-7501, a later model. features.role is quoted from Sony's 2000 PS one release, which calls the 1994 PlayStation 世界で最も普及したゲーム機 (the most widespread game console in the world).
external_ids: Wikidata Q10677 ('1994 5th generation video game console by Sony Interactive Entertainment') via the Wikidata API; igdb_platform 'ps' is Wikidata P5795 on that item.
